name: Windows History Native UI Ingress Probe
description: Manual-test-only probe that records the semantic events an operator's own native Editor edits produce, together with the native Undo entries those edits created.

permissions.reason: Read the native Undo managers and the Turboism history to record what an operator edit did.
Record the semantic operations the runtime confirms for an operator's own Editor edit.
Record the before phase of a native edit entry so the entry announcement can be compared with the commit.
